title: Log every divergence from the design
statement: Log every deliberate divergence from the design with the ruling that covers it, and say where the live build differs from what was authored instead of reconciling it quietly.
detail: The walkthrough of a built Grade 3 lesson logs every knowing divergence from its design in a deviations ledger with the ruling that covers it, and shows the open ones as amber flags (`downloads/SUPERSEDED — see v2 (table format)_ WITW Lesson 1 learning walkthrough.md`, line 15). It collects the open questions in one place so nothing hides in the prose (line 386), and its method note says that where a screen's behaviour on the live build differs from its authored intent, the difference is stated rather than reconciled quietly (line 387).
